source_refs.note: Topic 19.6 (PDF 136-137); the list of stages follows the headings of the next topic.

blocks.text: In translation, or protein synthesis, the information in an mRNA transcript is used to direct the order of amino acids in a polypeptide. It takes place on ribosomes and needs mRNA, tRNAs carrying amino acids, and enzymes and factors.

items: Activation of amino acids: each amino acid is joined to its tRNA.
Initiation: the ribosome, mRNA and first tRNA assemble.
Elongation: amino acids are added one codon at a time.
Termination: a stop codon ends the chain.
